page.overview:
What is Subjugation of the Anoat sector?

Sometime after the Clone Wars and during its reign, the Galactic Empire began a subjugation of the Anoat sector during its expansion into the Outer Rim Territories under the guise of Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine who had little tolerance for the Noble Court independence, and issued a number of kill orders on the nobles and took control over their domain.
